Results.ReviewText: I would give the Badger 31cc 4 cycle weedeater a 5 star rating for the motor. It is powerful and quiet. It doesnt loose power when you get into heavy weed growth, and cuts pencil size saplings with just the string trimmer.What keeps me from giving it a 5 star is that the gas cap threads on incorrectly half the time. Also, the harness doesnt fit properly. I tried several ways to wear it, but i ended up making my own harness. And, the balance is off. The ring for the harness was mounted forward of the throttle which made it too engine heavy. I had to move the ring between the throttle and engine to balance it. Now that I worked out the quirks i love it

Results.ReviewText: I just got this weed eater today by UPS. Just took about a week from a CPL states away. The only thing I didn't like or had a problem out of so far was, when I opened the box, the oil had leaked out of the motor all over the motor and motor shields. My opinion the should just send a bottle of oil with it instead of already in the motor. You know it gets shuffled and flipped around during transit. That's just my opinion, they may have a reason for it but, it made a mess! That end of the box where the motor sat was drenched with it. Anyway, I put it together easily, added more oil and gas, let it run for a bit to burn what oil I couldn't get to off then cut about 30 feet of weeds length wise, and it ran great! I also want to add, that it came with a nice shoulder harness and a 3 prong brushing cutting blade (untested as of now). All in all beside the leak, I'm one day completely satisfied right now! Thanks

Had product one day! Looked impressive in the box and put together. Assembled as per instructions, gas oil etc. Mowed my yard and was anxious to use the weed eater. It ran for about 10 minutes and died. Checked it over, fuel and oil and everything appeared fine. Went to restart after it had cooled off.
After 30 or 40 pulls on the rope and a sore arm, not even a sputter or whimper. NOTHING! I'll be returning this tomorrow!
Bottom line is this. If you want good quality, buy AMERICAN!

Results.ReviewText:
The trimmer arrived 2 days faster than I expected and was in perfect condition when it arrived.  This Badger is very strong but very quiet.   It idles to where you can have a conversation with somebody 6 feet away.   It cuts through anything in its' path and that is with the string that came with it.   I haven't even tried the brush cutter.  

It was easy to put together and once I filled it with gas and oil and pumped the bulb (10x/instructions), it started on the 2nd pull.  I had to rev it up since it was running so quiet to make sure it was actually running properly.   It is pretty heavy but balanced pretty good but the harness will be your friend for cutting more than normal.   I've used it for a few days and it will start on the first pull when cold.  

The harness is fairly simple to figure out and I like the quick release feature where you can pull the red cord and release the trimmer just in case it catches fire or something.     

Overall I like the quality, ease of use, and the warranty.  I bought the extra 2 years.

311424786.Description: Stop mixing oil and gas and take control of your lawn care with the powerful and versatile Wild Badger Power 4-Cycle Straight Shaft 2-in-1 Grass Trimmer and Brush Cutter. This tool has a grass trimmer attachment for detail work along borders and a brush cutter blade for heavier grasses and brush clearing. It also includes a harness to relieve the strain on your arms and improve stability. Powered by a 31cc, 4-cycle, full-crank engine, your trimmer is designed for reliability. The full crank design delivers a fast start and smooth operation reducing emissions, increasing fuel efficiency and delivering longer life. The transmission is supported by an aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube which is lightweight and durable for added comfort and convenience. The twist-n-load bump feed trimmer head allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawn and landscaping looking clean.
